title: Content Library Still — living-room play

location.series: Cox Brand Collection — Lindsay Little / Periscope

slide_intent: Choose an active shared moment so entertainment is understood as something people do together.
strategic_value: The dance-game scene can associate Cox’s entertainment world with participation and household energy.
demonstration: Three people face a television showing a dance game in a bright living room.
practical_value: Frame both participants and screen so the relationship between their movements and the activity remains clear.

content_islands.name: Participants and screen
content_islands.spec: Arrange the standing figures around the television, keeping the child visible in the foreground.

content_islands.name: Domestic frame
content_islands.spec: Retain the sofa back, plants and light furnishings as a recognizable home setting.
